analysis:
The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. Per file_changes, the diff is a documentation-only edit: the 'Last updated' date, and the GLM5 media/video text around base lines 810-811 and 827 (head 810-813, 829, 876-880). The text now says variable-frame-rate video is indexed using nominalFrameRate instead of being refused with a deterministic 400. The supplied units (base lines 1611-2365) are unchanged surrounding context and contain no modified lines. The patch excerpt is truncated at the head 876-880 range, and that range was not visible in the supplied text.

No code, config, or enforcement changes are visible. I found no change to the prefix-cache (T-041), attestation, authorization or key-handling security boundaries. The documentation edit describes a processor behavior change: VFR tracks are no longer refused and are timed at i/nominalFrameRate, with the frame cap (maximumDecodedBytes, 512 MiB) and the prepared-pixel cap unchanged. If a code change accompanies it, then reviewing bounded decode work, memory reservation and DoS exposure for VFR inputs (T-010, TB-007) belongs to the source change in GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset. That code is not in this batch, so I cannot confirm that the caps still hold. Media requests are still documented as excluded from prefix lookup and capture, so there is no cross-tenant cache impact. The hunk at head 876-880 is cut off in the excerpt, so I cannot confirm its content. I recorded this uncertainty and did not report it as a finding.
